The '''Gormak work camp''' was a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] camp located near the [[Interpreter's Retreat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]].

==History==
During the [[Third Galactic War]], the Gormak work camp was used by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] workers involved in the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]], a joint [[Voss (species)|Voss]]-Gormak effort to restore the Voss shrines — including the [[Shrine of Judgment]] and the [[Shrine of Contemplation]] nearby — damaged during the [[Invasion of Voss]] by the [[Eternal Empire]].<ref name="TOR:UV" />

Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|7.3}}</ref> during the [[Czerka invasion of Voss]], a team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of [[Czerka Interstellar]] attacked the Gormak work camp. Eventually, the Czerka forces were defeated by the [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]].<ref name="TOR:UV" />
